long_biography.plain_text:
The idea behind Ibo Maraca came from Effie Vakaki's collection of Panama hats and her feeling that classic examples lacked distinctive design. Christina helped turn that observation into a Greek label in 2014, collaborating with artists on hand-painted pieces and shaping their presentation. The venture later extended its craft-led approach to bags, jewellery and other accessories.

Vakaki's professional direction diverged from succession at Jumbo, the listed retailer founded by her father, Apostolos-Evangelos Vakakis. Explaining a share sale in 2021, he said one daughter would remain to run the company while the other was not involved and followed another path. Current corporate materials identify Sofia Vakaki as an executive director. Christina's public business identity instead centres on design-led entrepreneurship outside the family-controlled group.
